relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: It binds allosterically to the VSD2 domain and stabilizes NaV1.8 in a closed, nonconducting state [13,15,25].

relationships.subject: CYP3A
relationships.evidence_quote: Hepatic metabolism occurs mainly through CYP3A, and M6-SUZ retains NaV1.8 activity despite approximately 3.7-fold lower potency than the parent compound [14,25].

key_findings: Scoping review: suzetrigine is a highly selective NaV1.8 inhibitor (IC50 3 nM, >30,000-fold selectivity) with efficacy over placebo in postoperative pain trials.
NaV1.8 inhibition attenuates but does not abolish nociceptor firing, likely due to residual NaV1.8 current and NaV1.7 activity.
